dedupe_keys.name: viadonau projektdatenbank austrian danube waterway river restoration flood protection and inland navigation projects since 2000

description: viadonau, the Austrian federal waterway company responsible for the Danube, publishes a database of the projects it runs or joins. The database read on 2026-09-28 can be filtered by start year from 2000 to 2026 and can include completed projects; recent entries include the reconnection of the Haslau-Regelsbrunn side arm system (river km 1902 to 1895), the cross-border reConnect project reattaching two March meanders with Slovakia, bank restoration in the Horizon Europe Restore4Life project, the Nature Connect Dyje/Thaya meander reconnections, the iNNo SED project on sediment management against riverbed erosion and reservoir silting, the DiVINE and PLATINA4Action projects on inland navigation, and COMEX2 on River Information Services corridor management. Each entry gives a short description of aims and measures. Coverage is the Austrian Danube and its tributaries, with partners in neighbouring countries. Access is free on the web; no licence is stated. Caveats: entries are narrative and carry no structured cost or asset data. It supports planning studies of waterways, such as tracking restoration and navigation measures that change flood and low-water conditions. No related viadonau record is catalogued.
